task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Push down on the blue stapler with shiny silver parts to staple papers.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。机械臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，向下推动带有闪亮银色部件的蓝色订书机来装订纸张。
